metadata.title: Establishing the Polynomial Wolff Axioms for $δ$-Separated $δ$-Tubes With #o-minimality
metadata.abstract: We establish the full version of a conjecture of Guth and Zahl, giving a lower bound for the volume of a semialgebraic set that has a large intersection with a collection of $\delta$-separated $\delta$-tubes. Our proof uses o-minimal methods to simplify the proof of Katz and Rogers, who proved the conjecture up to a small factor. We also establish that the constants depend polynomially on the complexity of the semialgebraic set, and more generally in the #o-minimal setting.

analysis.workSummary: 作者证明大量相交于 δ-分离 δ-管的半代数集合满足 Guth–Zahl 猜想的完整体积下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 去除已有结果中的小因子损失，并给出复杂度的多项式常数控制。
analysis.limitations: 适用于规定的管分离与可定义性环境，不等于一般 Kakeya 猜想。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 ChatGPT 用于基础英文、排印编辑和少量格式整理，并声明未用 AI 进行实质数学工作。
